name: @3d-dice/dice-box
author: Frank Ali (3Ddice)
notes: Contents: dist/ from the npm tarball (ES module entry dist/dice-box.es.js, workers world.*.js, Dice.js, style.css, assets/ammo/ammo.wasm.wasm, assets/themes/default) plus LICENSE and package.json. package.json lists @babylonjs/core, @babylonjs/loaders, @babylonjs/materials 5.57.1, copy-dir, node-abort-controller as dependencies, but dist is already bundled: Babylon is inlined in Dice.js and world.offscreen.js, and dist files only import each other by relative path, so no extra runtime packages are needed in the browser. copy-dir is used only by the npm postinstall script (copyAssets.js, not copied). The library needs assetPath pointing at dist/assets/ when initialised. .map and .min.js variants are kept; the non-minified or minified set alone is enough.
